Zee5 Removes Diljit Dosanjh's 'Satluj' from Streaming Platform

The streaming platform Zee5 has removed Diljit Dosanjh's film 'Satluj' just two days after its release, citing unspecified reasons. The film was released on July 3, 2026, and became unavailable on the platform on Sunday. The move has sparked controversy among fans of the actor.
